summary: Frontend-only regression + homepage refinement verification for AMYA. All 12 spec items passed. Hero copy ('Your oil. / Your questions. / Our open process.' with 'Transparency-first cooking oil' eyebrow) is correct, no oversized duplicate AMYA logo in hero body (only header logo). Both hero CTAs work: hero-book-btn smooth-scrolls to #book-session and reveals home-booking-form; hero-explore-oils-btn navigates to /shop/oils. Oil showcase renders exactly 4 cards (groundnut, sesame, coconut, sunflower) all with 'COMING SOON' badges. Machinery area shows the clean placeholder (data-testid machinery-image-area); no ghani/wooden-press imagery detected. Booking form validation shows error toast on empty submit, and successful submission POSTs /api/bookings, shows home-booking-success, and opens a WhatsApp link with the correct number 919675334567 (URL uses api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=919675334567 — functionally equivalent to wa.me). 'Beyond our oils' section visible. Regression: /admin/login works, Bookings tab shows the newly created 'TEST Playwright' booking with 'pending' status; /live-press loads with booking-form visible (7 inputs); /contact form renders. Mobile (390px): no horizontal scroll, headline not clipped, CTAs tappable (350x48 button).

issues: Minor: WhatsApp opener uses api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=... instead of wa.me/<number>. Both are valid WhatsApp URLs and the phone number (919675334567) is correct, so no functional impact. Spec text said 'wa.me' — only mention if strict URL format is required.

critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx scrollToBook relies on window.__lenis — confirmed working via SmoothScroll component. Fallback to native scrollIntoView is correct.

HomeBooking filters oils via live_press flag — all 4 current oils have live_press=true so dropdown is populated. If any oil toggles live_press=false it will silently disappear from the dropdown; consider showing all oils or an empty-state message.
Console warning observed from a motion/scroll container ('ensure non-static position') — cosmetic, non-blocking.
